title: Every control, audited and on record
label: Five concentric rings roll apart into a row of five empty seals. A press stamps each seal in turn, left to right: SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA and PCI DSS. Each impression is lettered with its framework and scope, and a dated audit stamp lands beneath it with the number of controls it covers. A status line counts the controls as each seal is stamped, from 0 to 212 of 212 controls passing, and its bar fills one segment per seal. The scene holds on the full row stamped.
heading:
Audited by others,
not just promised by us.
sub: Five frameworks, each checked by an outside auditor. Every control they cover is monitored continuously, so the stamps stay true between audits.
